about.description: Gold perpetual market quoted against PAX Gold (PAXG), where each PAXG token represents one troy ounce of London Good Delivery gold. The contract gives linear exposure to the PAXG/USD price (tracking gold) without owning PAXG, the underlying gold, or redemption rights, with pricing referencing an external feed via the Stork decentralized oracle. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDT.
